shared_values: A Formula 1 race is decided by open, timed results that every team can check. Uniswap runs trading on public blockchains, where every swap is open, checkable and settled in seconds.
f1_audience: 827M fans in 2025, up 12% in a year, with 43% under 35 and 42% female. Fans index 146 for interest in technology, 200 for brand loyalty and 126 for researching online before buying (general population = 100), and purchase consideration is up 39% among Gen Z.
